message.content: {"winner":"A","evidence_A":"About 58 words, slightly under 60. Joins naturally with \"И дальше\". Develops the mechanism of the childhood schema: adult life is read through it, an invisible judge keeps account, and justice gets constructed. Somewhat abstract. Its closing line is a little awkward.","evidence_B":"About 55 words, under range. Moves quickly to \"reality owes nothing\", which restates the thesis that there is no justice. Has a grammar slip (\"перестаёт вписаться\"). Ends on a neat quotable line (\"без неё страшно\") instead of developing the fairy-tale mechanism.","comparative_reason":"Both run short. A develops the specific fairy-tale-schema mechanism more directly. B leans on restating the thesis, has a grammatical error, and closes with an aphorism that substitutes for development."}
